methodologyNotes: Covers two-channel (stereo) integrated amplifiers that combine a preamplifier and power amplifier in one chassis, sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes AV receivers, standalone power amps, standalone preamps, and mono blocks. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. powerPerChannel8OhmW and powerPerChannel4OhmW are the manufacturer's rated continuous (RMS) output per channel with both channels driven, in watts; powerPerChannel4OhmW is null if the maker does not publish a 4-ohm figure. amplifierClass is an enum: 'A', 'AB', 'D', or 'tube-hybrid' (valve preamp with solid-state output). thdPercent is rated total harmonic distortion at rated power, as a percentage (lower is better); null if not disclosed. snrDb is the rated signal-to-noise ratio in dB (higher is better); null if not disclosed. builtInDac is a boolean: true if an onboard digital-to-analog converter with digital inputs is fitted. phonoStage is an enum: 'none', 'MM' (moving magnet only), or 'MM/MC' (both). bluetooth is a boolean for onboard Bluetooth audio receiving. analogInputs is the count of line-level analog inputs (RCA plus XLR pairs), excluding the phono input. digitalInputs is the count of digital audio inputs (coax, optical, USB). headphoneOutput is a boolean for a dedicated front-panel headphone jack. weightKg is unit weight in kilograms.

The US MSRP of $1,199 is corroborated by The Audio Legacy ($1,199.00) and Dedicated Audio ($1,199.00) plus SpeakerDecision's stated "MSRP of 1199$".
